//: Supabase Edge Functions run on DENO, not Node. This file tells the Deno language server (and the VS Code TypeScript server) that these are Deno modules, so that: https://deno.land/... and https://esm.sh/... imports resolve instead of erroring with TS2307 'Cannot find module', Deno.* globals exist, and untyped remote modules stop cascading into a flood of TS7006 'implicitly has any' errors. Ref: https://supabase.com/docs/guides/functions/local-development
